svg.title: MSU Alpha named spots: court regions and coaching spots
svg.desc: Half court in metres, rim centre at (0, 0). Shaded: the 12 court_region cells (region names on the left half). Dots: coaching-spot anchors (named on the right half). Generated from config/named_spots.yaml version 0.3.0 by tools/specgen/named_spots/gen_svg.py.

g.text: Named spots: court regions (shaded) and coaching spots (dots), metres
1 m = 3.28 ft. Left/right as the attacker faces the basket. Mirrored regions are named once (left half); spots are named once (right half).
